findings.claim: numericID no longer wraps the strconv error (the %w is removed). A purely numeric id that overflows int64 now yields only 'has an id that is not a number', and the 'value out of range' cause is lost. Any caller using errors.Is/As on strconv.ErrSyntax, ErrRange or *strconv.NumError also stops matching. The diff does not show whether such a caller exists.

evidence: Only the diff was inspected, not the callers of numericID.
The test change checks that the id appears exactly once in the message, which the new message satisfies.
The test refactor, which turns the anonymous struct into a named propagationWalk type, introduces no defect.
